newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dai-Ichi Kyoken, Gakuikusha to merge on April 1998.
newsitem.headline: Dai-Ichi Kyoken, Gakuikusha to merge on April 1998.

text.p: Japanese operator of cram schools Dai-Ichi Kyoken Co Ltd plans to merge with Gakuikusha Co Ltd, which manages preparatory schools, on April 1, 1998, the two companies said on Friday.

The two companies said in a statement that they had signed a pact on the planned merger, which they said will ensure an effective use of business resources and the expansion of their market share in the Japanese education industry.
Under the agreement, one Gakuikusha share will be exchanged for 1.3 shares of Dai-Ichi Kyoken, and Gakuikusha will be dissolved, the companies said.
Shares of the two firms have been temporarily suspended on the over-the-counter market from the start of trading on Friday.
On Thursday, Dai-Ichi Kyoken shares ended the session at 624 yen, while Gakuikusha stood at 740 yen at the close.
It is not yet clear when the Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA) will allow trading of the shares to resume.
